svg.title: B03 ORION CROSSINGS — Gila Monster Road Ecology engineering architecture
svg.desc: The diagram preserves movement, exposure and survival as separate evidence paths and shows where restricted tracks enter the analysis. It does not turn uncertain telemetry intersections into confirmed road crossings.
